about: The expected graph model, format 3, of test-source-mvp2 (mvp_docs/55_viewer_backend.md, BE-110 to BE-115). index and inventoryFiles are mechanical, from the hand-written graph and the listing; views and display are written by hand. Relations are named by key: '<at> <kind> <to>' for a use, 'link <from> <to>' for an import. A view's edges are [from, to, kind, [relation keys]] where given; edgeCount and relationCount where given.
